unusual_events.explanation: Unusually large magnetic field: B_max = 52.0 nT (3.7σ above mean). Possible causes: magnetospheric compression, flux tube boundary, current sheet crossing, or reconnection inflow region.

Fast electron beam: mean V_e = 361.4 km/s > 300 km/s threshold. Ratio v_beam/v_th = 0.0811. When v_beam >> v_thermal, the electron velocity distribution function develops a positive slope df/dv > 0 at v_phase = ω_pe/k, which is the classical two-stream instability condition. Theory (Eq.18) predicts maximum growth rate γ_max at k_res = ω_pe/v_beam.
